Coverage and limits

The 187-pair denominator is closed against this ASMB-787 firmware image. Each pair has an exact-target handler contract, but a named raw command is not necessarily a structured codec or a live-reachable plugin. Of 462 operations, 381 remain raw-exact because their framing cannot safely be represented by the fixed-width codec. Activation is distinguished below: 92 static, 93 runtime-registered plugin, and 2 skipped plugin rows.

Safety boundary

The handler inventory includes 157 mutating, 55 security-sensitive, and 31 destructive operations. Every operation is tagged and filterable below; expand these lists to see the exact commands and observed effects. zipmi requires --unsafe for named operations whose payload or effect is not proven safe.

Complete 187-entry firmware dispatch catalog and zipmi named raw surface for unique vendor NetFn/Cmd pairs. Evidence separates 92 statically registered core/platform rows, 93 runtime-registered plugin rows, and 2 plugin rows skipped because their exact feature token is absent. The CmdHndlr_T layout is cmd@+0, privilege@+1, handler@+4, the one-byte dispatcher request-length constraint at +8, and interface@+12. Earlier documentation swapped privilege and request length.

A named command means zipmi can emit its exact NetFn/Cmd bytes. It does not claim a structured codec, complete request/response semantics, or runtime reachability. The +8 value proves only the dispatcher constraint shown; payload fields remain explicitly unknown unless AMI client/header material supplies labelled context. Type-8 secondary selector hooks exist, but their selector values remain unknown.

Exact-target operation contracts

Exact handler decompilation currently proves 462 operations across 187 command pairs. zipmi generates structured fixed-width codecs for 81 operations; the remaining 381 retain exact raw contracts because their variable, union, checksum, or overlapping-bitmask framing needs a dedicated codec. The analyzed firmware is artifact 379c676d-4d49-52ea-a268-541c391a69ca.
